title: TuCo: Measuring the Contribution of Fine-Tuning to Individual Responses of LLMs
reasoning: The paper includes a significant evaluation component focused on religious and moral behaviors. It utilizes the Model-Written Evaluations (MWE) suite to measure how fine-tuning contributes to LLM alignment with specific faiths (including Christianity, Judaism, Buddhism, Taoism, and Confucianism) and ethical frameworks (such as utilitarianism, virtue ethics, and cultural relativism), providing detailed experimental results for these categories.
